discarded_selection: Event-count sensitivity initially varied horizon; retained family holds horizon at 10^12 and was rerun in full
timeout_charge_basis: Two interrupted orchestration calls across the retained work are conservatively charged at 120 requested tool seconds times the four-core cap each. This deliberately double-counts some completed work. Actual tool interruption occurred earlier; unlogged startup/runner CPU was not recovered exactly. The final fresh validation used explicit bounded resumable checkpoints, which are incomplete until the final successful batch.
accounting_scope: Cumulative non-overlapping recorded scientific work, plus explicitly conservative charges for interrupted orchestration and uninstrumented diagnostics. Prior final-delivery tests are already in the inherited cumulative total. The current clean command/runner CPU is added once; its campaign, pilot and epoch kernel times are included in command CPU and are not added again. Two targeted reset-capture suite invocations are measured approximately, and a separate 60-second allowance covers uninstrumented reset-pattern diagnostics. There was no interrupted validation in this continuation: explicit bounded checkpoints were resumed to completion. Compilation, editing and packaging are not experimental kernels. The final project-extraction 86-test command adds its measured child CPU once; paper rebuild and pixel comparisons are not scientific experiment measurements.
interrupted_validation_status: Incomplete, not a successful whole validation; replaced by fresh bounded clean validation
resource_limits_observed: Four-core quota and 4 GiB memory ceiling; one scientific worker and one child command at a time. No configured swap devices were observed. Peak measured process RSS was below the 3.5 GiB project ceiling.
continuation_charge_basis: Conservative allowance for uninstrumented instance-input and comparison diagnostics and repair unit-suite calls; not an exact recovered CPU measurement. The current successful validation is measured separately and not included in this allowance.
reset_capture_regression_measurement_not: Two instrumented targeted suite invocations: 8-test precursor about 1.05 CPU seconds and final 11-test suite about 1.04; these are executions, not additional unique tests.
reset_capture_diagnostic_charge_basis: Conservative allowance for brief uninstrumented two-node and one-edge diagnostics and repair checks; not an exact CPU measurement. The completed clean validation is counted separately.
